title: 第21章 灵髓液 求推荐求月票第22章 鱼龙丹章程 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
甲三十六号洞府前，赤岩嶙峋，青苔点点。
楚无忌入洞府后，先将主室细细看了一遍。
石榻、石案尚在，几处石架只余磨蚀的槽痕。其余器物早被搬空，显然宗门回收洞府时有过清理。
空气里有些潮气，却并无久闭洞府常见的浊腥霉腐。
他眉梢不动，神识轻轻放出，沿着洞府内每一寸石壁扫过。
本欲先清理旧禁制残痕，忽然间，一缕极轻微的灵气波动自洞府内部一闪即逝，又迅速归于平缓。
若是寻常新晋筑基，神识尚未稳固，多半只当洞府灵气随地脉起伏，无意间的波澜，不会深究。
偏偏楚无忌筑基根基扎实，神识比同阶更凝，且今日在丹枢殿里听了洪玄易三人那番关怀，心里那点疑云一直未散。
此刻这缕异样，便像眼中尖刺，过于醒目。
他神识如水铺开，沿洞府穹顶、四角、地面一寸寸慢慢扫过，神识掠到闭关密室左侧岩壁时，竟有一丝极淡的滞涩。
他不动声色地踱到洞府中央，袖中两指轻捻，自储物袋中取出数枚阵旗，一道阵盘。
随即他掐诀一引，洞内灵气微微一沉，风声与潮汽交缠，室内明暗忽闪，仿佛置身潮雾之中。
风波元潮阵。
此阵以风水相杀，妙用无穷，最擅遮蔽神识窥探，看上去竟隐隐有假丹之势。
阵势一成，洞府就像被一层层雾潮包裹起来，外人若以神识探来，只会觉得浪潮翻涌，难以窥探内里情形。
阵成的一刻，他并不多看，转身步入内里密室，站在石壁前，才抬手轻敲石壁。
“咚。”
楚无忌眉峰微挑，眼睫微垂，他抬手取出一柄小巧黑剑，剑身薄如蝉翼，寒光内敛。
他沿着石壁上一条不起眼的旧缝轻轻一划，石粉簌簌落下。
他手腕一抖，黑剑连点数下，一层层石皮被剥开。

石皮剥到第九层时，露出一道嵌在石壁里的石质敛息阵盘。阵盘表面灰暗，纹路却隐约可见。
阵盘边缘还抹着一圈灵蜡封口，封得不算精细，蜡线有些许起伏，像匆匆抹上去的，却足够遮住细微灵气波动。
楚无忌心里冷笑一声，面上仍不动声色。
吴迪坐化十余年，洞府回收时宗门必有清点。此物能留到今日，要么当年清点之人心不在焉；要么清点的人根本就不想清点干净。
他将那敛息阵盘轻轻取下，放在掌心，细细探查。
阵盘边缘的灵蜡竟带着微弱清香，蜡质也新，分明是近年才抹上去的，绝非十年前旧物。也就是说，此处在近年内曾被人开启过，又重新封回。
楚无忌眸光一寒，眼底冷意一闪而没，唇角却几不可察地往上翘了翘。
他将阵盘收回储物袋中，阵盘取下后，露出后方凹槽石壁，随后他指尖一点，将石壁慢慢破开。
片刻钟后，石壁后竟露出一个拳头大小的空腔，空腔边缘的石层被磨得很细，显然曾多次开合。
空腔下方的石窝中凝着一滴淡青色液珠，晶莹欲滴，饱含灵气，隐含木之生机与风之轻灵，两股气机交融自然，如灵脉自孕、天地自成。
楚无忌瞳孔微缩，心头猛跳一下，连呼吸都停滞了半息。
“灵髓液……”
content_en:
In front of Cave No. 36, the red rocks are rugged and dotted with moss.
After Chu Wuji entered the cave, he first took a closer look at the main room.
The stone couch and stone table are still there, with only abrasion groove marks remaining on several stone shelves. The rest of the artifacts had been evacuated long ago, and it was obvious that the sect had cleaned up the cave when they recovered it.
There is some moisture in the air, but there is no turbidity or mold that is common in long-closed caves.
Without moving his eyebrows, he gently released his consciousness and swept along every inch of the stone wall in the cave.
I wanted to clean up the remaining traces of the old restriction first, but suddenly, a very slight fluctuation of spiritual energy flashed from the inside of the cave, and then quickly calmed down.
If it is an ordinary new foundation building, the spiritual consciousness has not yet been stabilized, and most of them will only think that the aura of the cave aura rises and falls with the earth's veins, and will not delve into the unintentional waves.
However, Chu Wuji's foundation was solid, and his spiritual consciousness was more concentrated than that of his peers. Moreover, after hearing the care from Hong Xuanyi and the others in Danshu Hall today, the doubts in his heart still lingered.
At this moment, this strange thing is like a sharp thorn in the eye, too eye-catching.
His consciousness spread out like water, slowly sweeping along the dome, corners, and ground of the cave, inch by inch. When his consciousness reached the rock wall on the left side of the hermitage room, there was actually a very faint stagnation.
He calmly walked to the center of the cave, lightly twisted his sleeves with two fingers, and took out several formation flags and a formation disk from his storage bag.
Then he drew the secret, and the spiritual energy in the cave sank slightly. The sound of wind intertwined with the moisture, and the light and dark in the room flickered, as if he was in the fog.
Stormy tide array.
This array uses Feng Shui to kill each other, and has endless magical effects. It is best at blocking the prying eyes of the spiritual consciousness, and it seems to have the potential of a fake elixir.
Once the formation is complete, the cave seems to be wrapped in layers of mist. If outsiders use their spiritual sense to explore, they will only feel that the waves are surging, and it is difficult to pry into the situation inside.
The moment the formation was formed, he didn't look much, turned around and walked into the inner secret room, stood in front of the stone wall, and then raised his hand to tap on the stone wall.
"Boom."
Chu Wuji's eyebrows were slightly raised and his eyelashes were slightly drooped. He raised his hand and took out a small black sword. The blade was as thin as a cicada's wing, and the cold light was restrained.
He gently drew along an old and inconspicuous crack in the stone wall, and stone powder fell down.
With a flick of his wrist, the black sword struck several times, and the layers of stone skin were peeled off.
When the stone skin was peeled off to the ninth layer, a stone breathing formation disk embedded in the stone wall was revealed. The surface of the array disk is gray, but the lines are vaguely visible.
There is also a circle of spiritual wax sealing on the edge of the array disk. The sealing is not very fine. The wax line is slightly undulating, as if it was applied in a hurry, but it is enough to cover the subtle fluctuations of spiritual energy.
Chu Wuji sneered in his heart, but his face remained calm.
Wu Di has been incarnation for more than ten years. When the cave is recovered, the sect must be inventoried. This thing can be preserved to this day, either the people who counted it were not caring; or the people who counted it did not want to count it at all.
He gently took off the breath collecting array plate, placed it in the palm of his hand, and examined it carefully.
The spiritual wax on the edge of the array plate actually has a faint fragrance, and the wax is new. It was clearly applied in recent years, and it is definitely not something old ten years ago. In other words, this place has been opened and closed again in recent years.
Chu Wuji's eyes turned cold, the coldness in his eyes disappeared in a flash, but the corners of his lips curled up almost imperceptibly.
He put the array disk back into the storage bag. After removing the array disk, the grooved stone wall at the rear was exposed. Then he slowly broke open the stone wall with his fingertips.
A moment later, a fist-sized cavity was revealed behind the stone wall. The stone layer on the edge of the cavity was ground very fine, and it had obviously been opened and closed many times.
A drop of light cyan liquid is condensed in the stone nest below the cavity. It is crystal clear and full of aura, implying the vitality of wood and the lightness of wind. The two qi machines blend naturally, just like the spiritual veins conceiving themselves and the heaven and earth forming themselves.
Chu Wuji's pupils shrank, his heart beat violently, and his breathing stopped for half a breath.
"Spiritual marrow liquid..."
